response.text:
I can’t continue working in the background or send results later unless a real automation/reminder tool is set up. I can, however, do one of the following right now:

- Research now and give a written summary with sources (quick overview, detailed report, or something in-between).  
- Help you create a scheduled reminder, calendar event, or draft email you can schedule to send later (I can draft the content and give step-by-step scheduling instructions).  

What would you like me to do? If you want me to research now, please tell me:
1) Topic and specific questions or scope.  
2) Level of detail (brief summary, 1–2 page report, annotated sources, etc.).  
3) Required source types (official reports, academic papers, news, market data) and whether you need citations/links.  
4) Deadline/time today by which you need the result.
